_doc: Curtain product catalog — track, fittings (end brackets, ceiling/wall brackets, gliders), and fabric. Hand-edited. Generators consume this and emit specs/_partials/curtain-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_pricing_rule: Per-metre products (track, fabric) use baht_per_metre_min + _max. Per-unit fittings use baht_per_unit_min + _max. All prices are RANGES (placeholder until shopping confirmed).
_per_calc_rule:
Each fitting declares how its qty is computed per window:
  - 'per-window'              → 1 per window (× window qty)
  - 'per-track-metre'         → ceil(track_m_per_window × 100 / interval_cm) per window
  - 'per-curtain-width-metre' → ceil(fabric_m_per_window × 100 / covers_cm_per_unit) per window
The generator reads per_calc + the optional interval_cm / covers_cm_per_unit fields.
_sizing_assumption: Drop fits within the fabric bolt width (typical 280 cm bolt handles up to ~250 cm drop with hem/heading allowance). For taller windows that exceed the bolt, the math under-counts and the spec needs a hand-edit note. Verify in store.

ikea-vidga-track.name: IKEA VIDGA single-track curtain rail (140 cm, includes ceiling fittings)
ikea-vidga-track.notes: Cuttable aluminium rail. Standard length is 140 cm. Note: The current Thailand SKU 004.929.17 INCLUDES the ceiling mount fittings, so separate ceiling brackets are no longer necessary.

ikea-vidga-end-bracket.name: IKEA VIDGA end closing set
ikea-vidga-end-bracket.notes: Used to finish and close the track ends or create end returns.

ikea-vidga-mount-bracket.name: IKEA VIDGA wall bracket (6cm or 12cm)
ikea-vidga-mount-bracket.notes: ONLY required if wall-mounting (available in 6cm or 12cm projection). If ceiling mounting, brackets are already included in the 004.929.17 track.

ikea-vidga-glider-pack.name: IKEA VIDGA glider and hook pack (24 pack)
ikea-vidga-glider-pack.notes: Pack of 24 glider hooks. One pack covers ~2.4 m of finished curtain width (assuming 1 hook every 10cm).

ikea-fabric-by-metre.name: IKEA Fabric by the metre (e.g., DITTE / MINNA)
ikea-fabric-by-metre.notes: Corrected: IKEA fabrics by the metre are typically 140-150 cm wide, NOT 280 cm. If 280 cm width is required, look toward standard textile markets.

homepro-rod-generic.name: HomePro generic curtain rod (with finials)
homepro-rod-generic.notes: Adjusted price to reflect standard telescopic or custom-cut metal rods. Linked directly to HomePro Curtain Hardware category.

homepro-rod-bracket-generic.name: HomePro curtain-rod bracket pair (one set per window)
homepro-rod-bracket-generic.notes: One pair of mount brackets per window for the curtain rod. Linked to HomePro Curtain Hardware category.

homepro-panel-eyelet-generic.name: HomePro generic eyelet curtain panel (140 cm wide, 250 cm drop)
homepro-panel-eyelet-generic.notes: Pre-made eyelet panel. Linked directly to HomePro Window Curtains category. Calc: panels_per_window = ceil(window_width × fullness / panel_width).
